newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain paedophile network has ties abroad - police.
newsitem.headline: Spain paedophile network has ties abroad - police.

text.p: Spanish police said on Wednesday they had seized thousands of pictures, videos and computer diskettes in raids on a child pornography and prostitution ring which sold the images abroad.
The material was found in raids on eight apartments in the northeastern region of Catalonia.
"It is known that this network of child prostitution had contacts with other foreign organisations dealing in paedophilia to exchange and sell material," police said in a statement.
The newspaper El Pais said the group may have links to a major French paedophile network uncovered recently.
Police said 12 people had been arrested. They did not say how many children were involved but local media reports on Tuesday said sources close to the investigation put the number at about 40.
Spanish state television said the ring may have distributed the material in France, Mexico, the United States and other European countries.
El Pais said French police had found some of the videos produced in Barcelona when they broke up an extensive paediophile network and rounded up more than 800 people in June.

At a news conference in Barcelona, police displayed some of the 2,000 slides, 3,000 Internet images and hundreds of videos and diskettes seized during the swoop on the impoverished district of Ciutat Vella where the ring operated.
They also found medical reports on some of the children, credit cards, cameras and mobile phones.
The judge has declared the proceedings in the case secret and police did not identify any of the 12 suspects.
The suspects are charged with sexual abuse and aggression, prostitution of minors and production of child pornography.
Barcelona officials have confirmed that one of those arrested is a district councillor in Ciutat Vella. He was stripped of his post on Tuesday and expelled from the Socialist party.
Media reports said one suspect was a former teacher and director of a municipal recreation centre and another was a social worker.
Police said their investigation began in April. The first arrests were in June when they discovered a couple who had rented out their 10-year-old son as a prostitute at weekends for $200.
One of the three ringleaders was also arrested in June, newspapers said.
